network_enforcement: Every Lean subprocess runs under bubblewrap with an unshared network, a read-only host root, fixed environment variables, and a fresh temporary directory as its only writable bind. The outer Python reconciler performs local file, hash, process, and Git checks only.

expected_outputs.semantic_hash_policy: exact six-line negative release reconciliation summary

scope_boundary: This bounded worker recipe authenticates the current inputs, performs a network-isolated trust-zero narrow replay of the exact statement, L2 candidate, and conditional root composition, and checks a negative release decision. It reuses pinned warm artifacts and cannot master-accept the validation dependency, close a frozen obligation or the exact all-p root, supply H0/R0 or complete trust/provenance evidence, perform a cold offline release build, act as an independent verifier, or grant release acceptance.
